status: synthetic proposal for independent review; no implementation or gate result
assumptions: No proposed worker, private endpoint or runtime decoder is implemented.
Case descriptions and private field spellings are review notation, not adopted wire DTOs.
Future executable tests must independently challenge expectations and record the implementation/runtime/resource tuple.
scope: R14/R16; future imports, generated exports and authority seams

cases.setup: Future terminal package with pure library and worker binary
cases.probe: Build intended facade and worker mappings with protocol imported only by the binary
cases.expect: Positive build succeeds; library dependencies remain owned pure types and admitted primitives
cases.forbid: Counting a failing setup build as a successful forbidden-import test

probe: Library reads a clock, opens a socket/file or accepts an OS handle
Library invokes an output callback or evaluates grants
cases.expect: Each forbidden seam is rejected by reviewed module/import/dependency enforcement

cases.setup: Whole future package graph including features, targets and generated files
probe: protocol imports domain or terminal semantic state
terminal pure library imports worker facade
cases.expect: Reject each dependency cycle/forbidden edge across the evaluated build matrix
